# ADR-3094: A08: Prefer signed commits for protected branch 10

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unsigned history weakens audit trails.

## Decision

Repositories SHOULD prefer signed commits for protected branch 10 (A08-10) when defending against author spoofing.

## Consequences

Signing keys are centrally managed.
